title: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars

engine.name: SAGE 2 (RNA)
engine.evidence: cnc3game.dat imports d3dx9_29.dll, DINPUT8.dll, DSOUND.dll; content in .big containers; RetailExe/<version>/cnc3game.dat holds the versioned game binary, CNC3.exe is a launcher.
engine.notes: The game code is a .dat (PE DLL) selected from RetailExe by version; only 1.10 is treated as the current build here.

userState.evidence: publisher convention for the SAGE 2 titles; not present on this machine yet

dependencies.evidence: literal hostnames and service paths in cnc3game.dat
dependencies.communityReplacement: Revora C&C:Online (Tacitus client), still operating for Tiberium Wars in 2026
dependencies.notes: GameSpy shut down 2014-06-30; the remaining online stack is unusable without a replacement.
Only used by the online account path; no community FESL replacement is claimed here.
A failed servserv lookup is the offline-launch case this program has to measure.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII string scan of launcher and game binaries
staticAnalysis.limits: Both binaries are readable. Whether the offline launch stalls on servserv is unknown until a measured run.

notes: Kane's Wrath is a separate product with its own binary and product ids; findings here do not transfer to it.
